newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel to submit budget to parliament Oct 29.
newsitem.headline: Israel to submit budget to parliament Oct 29.

text.p: The Israeli government will submit its 1997 budget to the Knesset (parliament) on October 29, the Treasury said on Wednesday.
The Knesset has until December 31 to approve the budget, which includes a cut of 4.9 billion shekels or 3.2 percent of expenditure, excluding debt servicing.
The Treasury plans to submit the budget as approved by the government in July, despite widespread criticism that the cuts fall hardest on the poor.
The only change currently planned involves a proposal to charge Israelis for visits to the doctor. It is likely that the lowest income sectors will be exempt from the fee.
